channel.title: LA Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from LA Daily News (dailynews.com)

item.title: LA County Supervisors to consider rental protections for families disrupted by ICE raids
item.description: ICE raids left families without paychecks, behind on rent and facing eviction. The Board of Supervisors has options to increase the eviction threshold to two or three months.

item.title: Project Angel Food’s new kitchen in Hollywood can make 4.5 million meals a year
item.description: Founded in 1989, Project Angel Food provides food to over 5,000 homebound individuals.

item.title: New Kings winger Artemi Panarin ‘never wanted to go anywhere else’
item.description: Panarin, acquired from the New York Rangers on Wednesday just before the NHL’s Olympic break trade freeze, will make his Kings debut on Feb. 25 when they host Vegas.

item.title: Rams QB Matthew Stafford wins 1st NFL MVP award, says he’ll play next season
item.description: Stafford edges Patriots quarterback Drake Maye in the closest MVP race since Peyton Manning and Steve McNair were co-winners in 2003, then confirms his plans to return for an 18th season during his acceptance speech.

item.title: A look at how gender equality is changing the Olympics
item.description: Here's how the events at the Winter Olympics have grown over the years.

item.title: ‘Prophetess’ was a ‘voice of the Lord,’ ex-congregant testifies as hearing involving alleged San Bernardino murders begins
item.description: Shelley Martin received prophecies for Hemet-based His Way Spirit Led Assemblies, according to testimony. Charges stem from man's disappearance and boy's death.

item.title: USC women take control early to beat Northwestern
item.description: Jazzy Davidson has 21 points and six assists, Kara Dunn scores 18 and Kennedy Smith adds 17 points and 11 rebounds as the Trojans build a 25-point lead by halftime and cruise to an 83-65 road win.

item.title: Austin Reaves, Lakers edge 76ers despite Luka Doncic’s early exit
item.description: Reaves battles through a minutes restriction to score 35 points in his second game back from an extended layoff, leading the Lakers to a 119-115 comeback win while Doncic sits out the second half with a left leg injury.

item.title: Kings blitzed by Vegas in final game before Olympic break
item.description: The Golden Knights score on four of their first six shots to hand the visiting Kings their fourth loss in five games, 4-1. Trevor Moore scores for the Kings, but Adin Hill stops their 32 other shots.

item.title: Will Matt Mahan’s entrance shake up leaderless gubernatorial race?
item.description: Ultimately, the total inability of any candidate to distinguish themselves thus far has led to a vacuum where any two candidates out of half a dozen could plausibly advance.
